behavior_findings: The zero-update four-policy V23 paired assessment finished 332 terrain, 80 full-episode flat, 96 stair-end, and 96 15-cm-stair fixed cases under the same plus/minus 0.12-rad hip default. For each student the 15-cm suite has 12 continue-route and 12 stop-platform cases: V23 improved route_4m 11/12 to 12/12 and removed two physical terminations, but two-second platform dwell fell 11/12 to 9/12. The two source terminations were the same 9-level ascent at 1.2 m/s in the two command modes, labeled actuator_violation. On 20 matched flat cases, startup 12-leg pose RMS peak increased from 0.071 to 0.085 rad and terminal mean from 0.081 to 0.093 rad; startup worsened in 19/20 and terminal in 18/20. All four hips showed greater actual inward-angle peaks; the candidate did not solve persistent hip adduction. Nine-terrain fixed cases show wave route_4m 6/6 to 5/6, obstacle 6/6 to 4/6, and pit success 7/21 to 6/21, while ascent stairs improved 5/6 to 6/6. Select the older 34823 checkpoint as the posture-preserving source for one isolated 1000-update hip-request cost test, preserving both checkpoints and comparing the same cases afterwards. This does not establish a random success rate or the cause of the user's 15-cm real-robot fault; no fault code or real hardware joint telemetry was provided.
